## ✨ Feature Description

**Clear and concise description of what feature you want.**

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

Why do we need this feature? What problem does it address?

## 💡 Proposed Solution

How would this feature work? Describe the ideal solution.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Any alternative approaches you've considered?

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria

How would we know this feature is complete?

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 📊 Priority

- [ ] 🔴 Critical (blocks users)
- [ ] 🟡 High (important for roadmap)
- [ ] 🟢 Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] 🔵 Low (future consideration)

## 👥 Who Benefits

- [ ] Free users
- [ ] VIP users
- [ ] Merchants (B2B)
- [ ] All users

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, include wireframes, screenshots, or links to similar features.

## 📝 Additional Context

Any other information that helps?
